title: Open a pinned loopback enrollment connection using the invitation key
spec: Open one bootstrap connection to a numeric loopback address. Validate the trusted server name and invitation root fingerprint with the same TLS 1.3 transport as lab chat. Use an ephemeral short-lived self-signed Ed25519 certificate for the key derived from the invitation. Keep the bootstrap private key and DER in memory, and never present the credential on a server-unverified connection. Use one absolute deadline for Setup and Confirm with no extension, including buffered I/O. Pass the protected prompt its deadline and discard late responses. Use the same pinned root for T221 activation chain validation. No native key storage, credential file, CLI, ambient roots, or new third-party packages.
